description: Given a country (and optional state, Bundesland or UK nation), year (2026-2028) and vacation-day budget (1-30), computes the mathematically optimal non-overlapping set of bridge days (Brueckentage / ponts / annual leave hacks) that maximizes total consecutive days off. Supports English, German and French labels. Deterministic offline rules (python-holidays, MIT), 0 AI, nothing stored, under 50 ms. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/bridge-days-planner.

budget.description: Number of vacation days to spend (1-30)

country.description: ISO 3166 2-letter code or English country name (e.g. DE, GB, FR, US)

lang.description: Output language for labels: en, de, fr or local

region.description: Optional state/region/nation code (e.g. BY, NW, ENG, SCT, NIR, 57, CA)

name: bridge_days_planner
title: Bridge Days & Vacation Optimizer API - maximize days off from public holidays (200+ countries)
